answer: Admit identities through a token-curated registry: staked curators vote each applicant in, and anyone may challenge a suspect by staking against it — the loser's stake goes to the winners. A farmer must bribe or out-stake the curators for every single fake, so the bill grows with each clone instead of staying flat. Picture the registry as an island, the honest set a lotus at its centre, and a whisper of doubt enough to trigger a challenge vote. Limit: curators can collude, and a thin registry is cheap to capture.
